scholarships.name: DAAD-K.C.Wong Postdoc Fellowships **• DAAD**
scholarships.description: This scholarship programme allows scientists to carry out research with German colleagues at universities, universities of applied sciences and non-university research institutes in Germany.
scholarships.deadlineText: **9th October** for visits beginning between April and September of the following year **8th April** for visits beginning between October and March of the following year
scholarships.sourceQuote: Highly qualified Chinese scientists and researchers in the fields of natural sciences, mathematics, engineering, agriculture and medicine.

eligibility.sourceQuote: Applicants must be citizens of the People's Republic of China based in Mainland China and hold a teaching or research position at the time of their application; they are required to have obtained a PhD or an appropriate academic qualification.
